title: Executive Assistant to Business Owner | Remote | Part-Time
description:
**Please read the entire job description. Application instructions are at the bottom.**

Who We Are

We're a growing sales and corporate gifting business based in Reno, Nevada, serving thousands of customers nationwide.

We specialize in personalized corporate gifts, customer relationships, and live sales events across the country.

We're a small team with big goals, and we take pride in solving problems creatively, working efficiently, and providing exceptional customer experiences.

We're looking for someone who can help us continue growing while keeping everything running smoothly.

Who We're Looking For

**We're looking for a right-hand person, not just someone who checks boxes on a to-do list.**

We need an experienced, highly resourceful Executive Assistant who can handle a wide variety of responsibilities, think independently, and take ownership of projects from beginning to end.

One day you might be researching wholesale manufacturers. The next day you could be troubleshooting software, coordinating a marketing campaign, organizing travel, or helping resolve a customer issue.

You won't always know how to do everything we ask.

**That's okay. What matters is your ability to figure it out.**

We want someone who takes initiative, researches solutions, asks thoughtful questions, and follows through without needing constant supervision.

If you're naturally organized, tech-savvy, and genuinely enjoy solving problems, this could be a great opportunity.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a versatile position supporting the business owner across several areas:

* **Executive Support:** Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, travel arrangements, and administrative projects.
* **Research & Problem-Solving:** Research vendors, products, services, and business opportunities. Compare options and present recommendations.
* **Customer Relationships:** Respond to customer inquiries, maintain CRM records, coordinate orders, and manage follow-ups.
* **Marketing:** Assist with scheduling email and SMS campaigns, creating Canva designs, and coordinating social media content.
* **CRM & Technology:** Help manage HighLevel, troubleshoot software issues, maintain workflows, and learn new systems.
* **Project Management:** Coordinate with remote team members and vendors, track deadlines, and ensure projects are completed.
* **Event Coordination:** Research trade shows, communicate with organizers, and assist with travel and event logistics.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and make the business run more smoothly.

The Ideal Candidate

We're not necessarily looking for the person with the most impressive resume. **We're looking for someone who gets things done.**

You should be:

* **Resourceful:** You enjoy figuring things out, even when you've never done something before.
* **Independent:** You can manage projects without constant instructions or reminders.
* **Organized:** You can juggle multiple priorities while keeping track of important details.
* **Detail-Oriented:** You double-check your work and take pride in accuracy.
* **Proactive:** You communicate updates, anticipate problems, and take initiative.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership of your responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* **Tech-Savvy:** You're comfortable learning new software and troubleshooting unfamiliar systems.

We provide guidance and support, but we expect you to be comfortable researching solutions and working independently.

Requirements

* Previous experience in executive assistance, administrative support, or business operations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and common business software.
* Comfortable using Canva and learning new technology.
* Reliable computer and internet connection.
* Availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours; Pacific Time preferred.

**Bonus points for:** HighLevel experience, CRM management, marketing automation, customer service, or experience supporting entrepreneurs.

Compensation & Growth

* **Starting pay: $24–$28/hour**, based on experience and demonstrated abilities.
* Opportunities for quarterly bonuses tied to overall company sales performance.
* Approximately 10-20 hours per week initially, with potential for additional hours.
* Remote work with flexible scheduling.
* Paid training and onboarding.
* Employee discounts.
* Opportunities for increased compensation and responsibilities.

We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing alongside the business.

Our Values

**Truth:** Be honest, own your mistakes, and communicate openly.

**Responsibility:** Take initiative, follow through, and look for ways to contribute beyond the minimum.

**Heart:** Care about your work, your teammates, and the customers who depend on us.

We believe in working smarter, taking pride in what we do, and treating our customers' experiences as if they were our own.

How to Apply

**Attention to detail matters. Please follow these instructions carefully.**

Email your application to **QualityCustomGifts@gmail.com**.

**Subject line:** I actually read the instructions

Please include:

* **Your resume in PDF format**, named Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.pdf.
* **A brief introduction** explaining your relevant experience and why this position interests you.
* **Problem-Solving:** Tell us about a time you were given a problem you didn't know how to solve. What did you do, and what was the outcome?
* **Personal Question:** What does the following quote mean to you? *"Work is love made visible." - Khalil Gibran*

Please keep your responses thoughtful but concise. Specific examples are more valuable than generic answers.

**Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.**

Our Hiring Process

Qualified applicants will be invited to interview. Finalists may be asked to complete a brief, paid practical exercise to demonstrate their problem-solving and organizational skills.

**If you're a dependable, resourceful problem-solver who loves making things happen, we'd love to hear from you!**

Pay: $24.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Executive Personal Assistant – Wolf the Jeweler

Wolf the Jeweler is seeking a motivated, creative, highly organized, and responsive Executive Personal Assistant to support daily business operations, content creation, customer communication, and brand growth.

This role requires someone who can communicate naturally and professionally, manage social media interactions, and provide reliable day-to-day support.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create engaging social media content, including Instagram posts, Reels, and Stories.
* Develop creative content ideas that showcase jewelry, products, and the brand.
* Monitor and respond to Instagram DMs promptly and professionally.
* Respond to customers using genuine, personalized, human-written messages. **Automated responses, copy-and-paste replies, and robotic-sounding messages are not acceptable.**
* Engage with potential customers and help turn inquiries into sales.
* Maintain a professional and consistent online brand presence.
* Provide administrative and executive support as needed.
* Stay up to date with social media trends and creative marketing strategies.

**Important Communication Requirements:**

* Must be reachable and responsive during agreed-upon working hours.
* Must answer phone calls when I call. Being available and willing to communicate directly is a requirement of this position.
* Must have excellent communication skills and be comfortable speaking on the phone.
* Must take initiative, follow instructions, and communicate clearly without needing constant reminders.

**Ideal Candidate:**

* Creative with a strong eye for aesthetics, luxury, and branding.
* Experienced with Instagram and social media content creation.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and proactive.
* Professional, personable, and comfortable communicating with high-end clientele.
* Able to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Someone who understands that personal communication and customer relationships are essential to the business.

**Please Note:** I am looking for a real person who takes pride in their work, thinks independently, and communicates like a human being. I do not want someone who relies on AI-generated or automated messages to interact with customers. If I call you, I expect you to pick up or communicate promptly if you are unavailable. Responsiveness, accountability, and professionalism are non-negotiable.

Work Location: Remote

Pay: $400.00 - $1,800.00 per week

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Executive Assistant**  
**The Sponsorship Collective**

**Who you are**

You spot problems before they become problems. When something’s off, you fix it. When someone needs a nudge, you send it. When files are out of order, you sort them. You take initiative and anticipate what the business needs next.

You find real fulfillment in a supportive role because you know the difference you make. Things would fall apart without you, and you know it.

You’re both task-oriented and people-oriented: kind, pleasant, and a clear communicator. You care as much about getting things done as you do about delivering on the original goal. You often sense what others need before they’ve named it, and some people call you a mind reader.

Organization is your superpower. You juggle multiple projects, tasks, and timelines, and you bring calm to chaos. Friends regularly ask how you do it all. You thrive on structure, and you notice when something isn’t running efficiently. You’re happy to research best practices and put them into place.

You work well on a team and on your own. You understand that collaboration matters when everyone is working toward a common goal, and you know the role you play in that.

**Who we are**

We’re a consulting company that helps clients professionalize their sponsorship programs. We work with clients from all kinds of backgrounds to reach their sponsorship goals and grow their impact. Many clients join knowing nothing about their property, audience, or value, and within 90 days they’re closing six-figure sponsorship deals.

Our team is resilient, committed, and encouraging. We’re always looking to grow and improve, personally and professionally. We believe that when we bring our best, our clients and coworkers do too.

**About the role**

This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor position supporting the founder and CEO day to day. You’ll work across sales, marketing, client success, accounting, and operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the CEO’s personal and business calendar
* Respond to inbound communication across email and social media, including from vendors, prospects, clients, and team members
* Clear all inboxes daily, process messages, and assign them to the right person
* Review the private client Facebook group daily, flag posts needing a response, and post announcements and events
* Create slide decks for YouTube videos; edit videos (trimming, intro/outro templates, audio leveling) following SOPs; upload to YouTube and the website
* Process contractor invoices and verify timesheets
* Schedule emails in the CRM and build reports as needed
* Keep QuickBooks current with receipts and invoices, and work with the accountant on business and personal tax returns
* Take tasks off the CEO’s plate by project-managing them or delegating to the right team member
* Prepare, attend, and write minutes for internal team meetings; manage and schedule internal meetings
* Schedule social media and website marketing assets (ads, blog posts, web page content)
* Create, update, and maintain SOPs, playbooks, workflows, and process documentation as the company scales

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of administrative assistant experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong computer skills and working knowledge of G Suite (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs) and social media platforms
* 35 hours per week, during standard business hours in Eastern time zone

**Job type:** Remote, contractor, full-time

**Remuneration:**

· $3,500 USD per month retainer

· 35 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with a 1-hour unpaid lunch break each day

· Invoiced and paid semi-monthly

**How to apply:** Submit your resume via Indeed or email hello@sponsorshipcollective.com

Pay: $3,500.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

full_description:
Content Author

Job Description

The Content Author is an entry point into the content team's career path, combining hands-on content authorship with full ownership of the content production process. This role analyzes source material from multiple resources and writes, edits, and updates clear, accurate, customer-facing content, while also performing the technical production tasks — coding, copyreading, merging, rendering, loading, and validating — needed to move that content through the team's systems and into publication. The Content Author works under the guidance of more senior team members while building independent proficiency in the team's content, processes, and systems, with the goal of taking on progressively broader responsibility over time. Specific product knowledge is not required at entry; the role is designed around generalizable content and systems skills that apply across the team's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities 

Read source material from multiple places and write, edit, and update content so it's clear and correct, with guidance from senior team members. 

Handle the full content production process in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM): coding, copyreading, editing, merging, DITA formatting, and checking content. 

Turn confusing, incomplete, or mixed-up source material into clear, well-organized content for customers. 

Take ownership of your own content's accuracy and completeness; work independently on familiar tasks and ask for help on harder ones. 

Spot routine content problems, fix what you can, and know when to ask for help on anything unclear. 

Meet deadlines by managing your own workload and working well with teammates. 

Help test and review content to make sure it works and reads well across different formats. 

Suggest small process improvements when you spot them. 

Leverage strong product knowledge to enhance our workflow and content, for strategic products. 

Learn the team's content, systems, and tools, and pick up general product knowledge over time. 

Required Qualifications

Process-oriented: comfortable following and improving structured, multi-step content workflows. 

Attention to detail: consistently accurate, complete, and quality-checked work. 

Strong writing skills: clear, well-organized, professional writing across content types. 

Strong sense of voice: able to write and edit in a consistent, appropriate tone and style. 

Ability to deal with ambiguity: works effectively from incomplete, conflicting, or multi-source information and knows when to escalate. 

General product knowledge: comfortable learning new product context quickly; deep expertise in any single product is not required at entry. 

Works successfully in a team environment and understands team member roles. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Exposure to AI-assisted content tools or workflows. 

Familiarity with knowledge maps or other structured-content models. 

Basic content or data analytics skills. 

Experience with DITA or other structured-authoring frameworks. 

Experience working in a component content management system (CCMS). 

Broader content creation experience (e.g., digital, consumer-facing, or SEO-oriented content). 

Strong product knowledge in a strategic product area. 

#LI-HB1

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

Content Specialist 

 

Job Description 
The Content Specialist participates in a Content Operations team and assists in the creation and/or acquisition, preparation and delivery of assigned content and information for creating products and product functionality in all publication media (print or electronic). 

 

Key Responsibilities 

Publishing: Performs duties such as analyzing, keying, converting, coding, copyreading, editing, merging, rendering, loading, or validation of data. Supports team publishing goals by meeting deadlines. 

Quality Control: Responsible for accuracy and completeness of work product. All work will be checked until competent process knowledge is developed. 

Individual and Team Skills: Attends and participates in team meetings, prioritizes own work, and participates in the performance management process (e.g. peer reviews, self-evaluation). 

Content acquisition: Duties may include acquisition of manuscripts or core content, analysis of manuscripts and electronic files, coding (mark-up of data) and resolving coding errors, manuscript editing, compiling and editing of content, proofreading and copy reading, quality control and verification. 

 

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree required 

Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience 

Strong analytical skills with the ability to accurately key, convert, code, and edit data. 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to participate actively in team meetings and performance management processes. 

Ability to work under tight deadlines and support team publishing goals effectively. 

Candidates must be willing to work in a hybrid setup at our Mckinley Hill, Taguig office. 

 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Proficient in copyreading, proofreading, and editing, with a keen eye for detail to ensure quality and accuracy of content. 

Experience in content acquisition, including manuscript analysis, coding, and error resolution. 

Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks independently while maintaining high standards of work quality and completeness. 

Knowledge of XML, HTML, and AI tools is a plus 

Experience working in a BPO or shared services environment

Job description
Job Description
Job Title: AI Trainer Lead
Job Type: Contract
Location: Remote
Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Key Responsibilities:
Evaluate and score AI-generated responses using well-defined rubrics and metrics across diverse subject areas.
Annotate and categorize data sets to improve AI model accuracy and reliability.
Apply keen attention to detail in reviewing content for relevance, coherence, and factual accuracy.
Provide clear, actionable feedback on AI performance to inform ongoing model improvements.
Collaborate with the customer's team to interpret guidelines and contribute to rubric refinement.
Document findings and maintain meticulous records of annotations and evaluations.
Engage in critical reading and analysis of complex subject matter ranging from business and finance to marketing, healthcare, and legal domains.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data annotation and content evaluation.
Strong critical reading and analytical skills with the ability to interpret and apply rubrics.
Proficiency in written and verbal communication; ability to articulate nuanced feedback clearly.
Bachelor’s degree required.
Experience in evaluating or scoring large volumes of content against detailed criteria.
Experience with AI training, machine learning data annotation, or related tasks is highly valued.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fully remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
Background in business, finance, legal, marketing, healthcare, or research fields.
Prior experience in AI training, human-in-the-loop systems, or quality assurance of AI-generated content.
Familiarity with industry-standard annotation tools or AI evaluation platforms.
